description: Use when writing down what a feature does and why in a Dotkernel project — after building or changing a route, module, command or entity, when asked to document a feature, write release notes, record a decision, explain an endpoint to another developer, or bring an existing feature doc back in line with the code. Also use when a feature exists but nothing outside the code explains it, when a doc still describes behaviour that has since changed, and before adding behaviour to an area that already has a feature doc.
